verdict.rationale: Groq documents drop-in OpenAI compatibility via changing base_url and api_key with existing OpenAI client libraries, supporting chat completions, streaming, tool use, and a Responses API 'fully compatible with OpenAI's Responses API' — enabling an agent to switch providers without provider-specific code. Community evidence corroborates real-world usage of the API alongside other providers, though some reliability complaints exist (unrelated to compatibility itself). Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of true zero-code-change swap in a multi-provider agent framework.
